See it work. Every clip is the real app.

Pick a step or let it play.

  1. Your seller funnel, live the day you sign up.

    A five-step "sell your house for cash" form under your business name, phone number and address. Sellers finish it in about a minute on their phone, and it works with your Google and Meta ads from day one.

    • Compliance pages included: privacy policy, terms and SMS consent language written for A2P 10DLC
    • Assignment disclosure in plain English
    • Your own domain on Pro and Team, or $19/mo on Starter
    More on seller lead funnel

  2. Every lead arrives with the math done.

    Before you pick up the phone, the lead has been run against recent sales near the property: after-repair value, repairs, your max offer and where to open, plus what the seller owes.

    • Scored hot, warm or cold on timeline, motivation, condition and asking price
    • Mortgage and equity from recorded loans, plus pre-foreclosure, liens and auction dates
    • One tap to call, text, skip trace or move it to deals
    More on seller lead funnel

  3. Any address. About ten seconds.

    A call-in, a list lead, a house you drove past. Type the address and get comps with match scores, ARV, repairs, your offer range and a buyer pitch.

    • Payoff check: see if the mortgage is above your max offer before you call
    • Vacant lots priced per acre
    • Batch: paste 10 addresses and get every offer in one table
    More on deal analyzer

  4. Photos in. Repair budget and the after picture out.

    Upload up to 12 photos for a condition grade and line-by-line repairs. Then tap Show after repairs and the AI shows what the house could look like fixed up, to send to your buyers.

    • Line items with low and high ranges, tied to the photo they came from
    • Red flags and questions for the walkthrough
    • Before and after you can download, labeled as an AI concept
    More on photo repairs & ai after-repair

  5. Check the numbers. Print the contract.

    Each deal shows what your buyer pays and makes and whether it clears the 70% rule. Work the 18-point checklist and print the purchase agreement, assignment or JV agreement.

    • Pipeline: lead, offer sent, under contract, assigned, closed
    • Contracts filled in from the deal, with the Texas wholesaler disclosures
    • Send to buyers by email or text in one tap
    More on deal pipeline & underwriting

  6. Pull motivated owners by ZIP.

    Pull every owner in a ZIP from public records, keep the ones most likely to sell, and stack lists to find owners who show up on several.

    • Absentee, out-of-state, estates, long-time owners and vacant lots
    • Stack lists, including your driving-for-dollars list
    • CSV ready to skip trace
    More on owner lists & list stacking

Before you sign up

Where the numbers come from, what it won't do, and how billing works.

Still have questions?Talk to the founder for 15 minutes. We'll walk through your market and the plan that fits.Hop on a call
Where do the numbers come from?

Property details and recent sales come from public records and listing data covering the U.S. After-repair value is based on the closest recent sales by distance, size, age and date. Repair estimates use cost per square foot by condition, adjusted for the age of the house and any problems the seller reports. Every number is an estimate, so check comps and walk the property before you sign.

Can I see what the seller owes?

Yes. Every analysis pulls the recorded mortgages on the property: lender, original amount, rate and recording date, plus any liens, pre-foreclosure filings and auction dates. You get an estimated balance and equity, and a warning when the payoff is above your max offer. Confirm the payoff with the seller before you sign.

How do offers get calculated?

Max offer = after-repair value × 70%, minus repairs, minus your assignment fee. Your opening offer starts 5% below that so you have room to negotiate. On any deal you can change the ARV, repairs, contract price and fee and see the effect on your buyer's profit.

How does the free trial work?

Pick a plan and add a card. You get 3 days with every tool on, with trial limits of 25 deal analyses, 10 skip traces, 3 photo estimates, 3 AI after-repair renders and 60 JStar AI messages. Cancel before day 3 from Plan & account and you aren't charged. Otherwise your plan starts and the full monthly limits unlock. The trial is one per person and card.

What is Photo to ARV?

Upload photos of the property and get a condition grade and line-item repair estimate. Then pick a photo and tap Show after repairs: the AI shows the same space fixed up with typical flip finishes, keeping the layout, windows and roofline. Every download is labeled as an AI concept, not the actual property.

Does it work with GoHighLevel?

Yes. Connect your GHL sub-account with a Private Integration token and you can text every matching buyer at once from your A2P-registered number. JStar AI's follow-ups can also text sellers who agreed to texts on your funnel.

What doesn't it do?

JStar Pro isn't a dialer, and it doesn't send cold text campaigns to seller lists. It texts your cash buyers, and follows up by text only with sellers who opted in on your funnel. Pre-foreclosure filings and liens show on each property you analyze; they aren't a list you can pull yet.

Do I need my own website or domain?

No. Your funnel is live at your own link as soon as you sign up. On Pro and Team, or with the $19 add-on on Starter, you can connect a domain you own with two DNS records.

Are the contracts legally ready to use?

They're templates with the disclosures Texas requires for wholesalers, filled in from your deal, including a JV agreement. Laws vary by state, so have a real estate attorney in your state review them once before you use them.

What happens if I hit my monthly limit?

Your funnel keeps taking leads, just without the automatic analysis, until you add a pack, upgrade or the month resets. Packs never expire: +100 deal analyses $25, +25 photo estimates $15, +5,000 list records $25, +100 skip traces $25.

Can I cancel?

Yes, anytime, from Plan & account → Manage billing. You keep access until the end of the period you paid for.
